paragraphs: Chapter 953
Episode 235. Zito (2)
Poison was infiltrating through the wound.
If it wasn't for the Mandojoo and the Heavenly Flesh, my cheek would have melted and a hole would have been formed. Jin quickly distanced himself from Zito and stared at him.
'Hmm, is it because of that little thing that Ayula did to me? Despite being touched by my thorns, it's just as if you were cut by a regular sword.'
Zito remembered the choice that Ayula made the day he briefly descended into the Holy Kingdom.
It was true that Zito lost some strength because of that. About 20% to 30%. Zito didn't think that this would hinder him now, but seeing Jin all well and good made him feel somehow bitter.
As this space was Zito himself, it had properties that reacted according to his inner self.
Feeling a certain uncomfortable feeling, he began to form more thorns in the space. The destroyed ground, the soaring black rocks, and even from the air, thorns were growing.
Thorns also grew where Jin stood.
However, Jin did not avoid the thorns. The thorns shattered in Jin's golden aura even before they could break through the ground.
"It seems you are the type who talks a lot when scared."
[Huh?]
"I realized it while I was getting here. You were driving the demons mad to gather the power of pain to fight me."
[Ah, I see how it might look like that. However, it's not that I made our little ones eat each other consciously for you. That was just... a process to reach the end.]
"The end... are you talking about a new world where the order of pain you pursue has arrived?"
[Yes, exactly. What do you think pain is, Jin Runcandel?]
Zito's eyes, which had been playful and light all along, hardened for the first time.
"Well, I've never really thought about it."
[The essence of pain is ultimately to plunge the subject into nothingness. When the order of pain comes to the world, it means that insignificant things don't need to squabble about who is better.]
"So you want to purify the world with pain."
Suddenly, Kinzelo came to mind.
In the sense that they act to bring the 'perfection' they pursue to the world, Kinzelo and Zito didn't seem very different.
"One could say it's a kind of purification. I was born in pain. The pain that the true king and the creator of life, the sun god Kinzelo went through, materialized as me."
Zito put his Thorny Ax on his shoulder. The sound of flesh being torn and burst as the thorns dug into the shoulder was conveyed.
"Therefore, I can say that there is no one in this world who understands the essence of pain better than I do. In my early stages, I tried numerous times to be liberated from pain."
"Then you developed that strange taste. Feeling pleasure in pain."

"Tastes fall within the realm of choice. In my case, there was no choice. Do you think you can live a normal life submerged in boiling water every day? And the boiling water is just a simple explanation to help understand. The pain I've experienced is beyond what can be expressed in words or writing."
"I feel embarrassed because I don't feel any pity for you."
"What I want to say is this. I believe the world should suffer as much as I do. And ultimately, it's about being eroded by the endlessly deep and infinite sea of pain and forgetting oneself."
"So I'll stay as your plaything while I'm still conscious?"
"Yes. But the reason I chose you as a toy is not just because you look tasty... it's the same reason I chose Orgal as a successor."
"Orgal?"
"He has the ability to perceive the distortion of the world. He can recognize when a part of the world is erased or changes due to someone or some phenomenon."
-[Fate can sometimes be so cruel... your god too. Isn't that right, Murakan?]
-[...How do you know about this place and why did you suddenly appear?]
-[There's not much I don't know about in the world that is known, or not erased or distorted. You know?]
Suddenly, Jin remembered the conversation between Murakan and Orgal he heard in Temer's second tomb. In those records, Orgal had said there was a way to save Temer, who had become a monster.

[When the era of pain comes, the world will undergo many changes regardless of my will. Like the witch... So then, an entity that can recognize that fact and correct errors is needed. I only thought Orgal could do that, but my mind has changed after seeing you. The era of pain can only be completed with Orgal and you.]
"I see. So, is the complicated explanation over?"
Even though he called it a complicated explanation, Jin could now clearly understand the purpose of Zito, the immortal.
He simply wants to take revenge on the world.
That's why he used the demons as expendables because he doesn't need the people in the underworld, and it seemed he had no intention of sparing any life in the world in the future.
'The error he mentioned probably refers to variables that threaten the order of pain. And he wants to use Orgal and me as a safety device to eliminate such variables.'
Goosebumps rose.
Zito was not imperfect like the monstrous offspring born from Rosa, nor divided like the kings of the Black Sea. He was the most pure and massive incarnation of madness Jin had ever encountered.

[You cannot stop me, Jin Runcandel. Your will is lofty, but ultimately it is not as complete as mine. I am the fruit of pain that Kinzelo created and watched over the world, and his resentment. I am the lump of agony that has been passed down since the beginning of time.]
Screech! Clink-!
Zito formed a physical body on Jin's right side and swung his spiny axe. The moment Sigmund and the spiny axe collided, the golden thunder on the blade momentarily dispersed.
Zito wore a playful expression again. However, the spiny axe became more violent and its toxicity deepened.
Jin also pulled up his energy to match him, but there was a limit.
‘To fully deploy Sun Splitter, I need to create an opening, but a lot of energy needs to be consumed to do that...'
That was the problem.
This fight had a structure that could not reach the end without using a lot of power in the process.
‘I miss Murakan. If he were here right now, I could have made an opening without much effort. Instead of going for a short-term fight, it might be better to bide my time and wait for Murakan.’
If he chooses a short-term fight as initially thought, there is a risk of deploying Sun Splitter with insufficient power, and a long-term fight risks Murakan not reaching here.
Jin didn't know what the situation was outside the door now.
After Zito dragged him in, he couldn't confirm whether the portal leading here was still open or had disappeared.

‘According to Zito, Murakan and his party are currently dealing with Kelliark. Whether Murakan is still in a state to continue fighting after dealing with him is also a key factor... It's all very tiring.’
Soon Jin made a decision.
The golden thunder spreading near Jin began to rage even more.
‘If I can't get a chance to use Sun Splitter, there's no chance of winning. I don't know what could happen while waiting for an ally who may never arrive.’
He didn't know how much energy would be needed to create an opening in Zito. If he couldn't tire him out, victory was impossible.
[Oh, looks like you're finally ready to fight properly? That's right, considering this and that, you look cool!]
Jin charged at Zito and thrust Sigmund. The lightspeed thrust expanded by the golden thunder left a bright afterimage in the air, piercing through Zito's chest.

Zito swung his thorny axe at Jin, who was charging at him even though his chest had been pierced. Jin, while pressuring him, managed to parry all the thorns popping out from the rear, and every time, Zito's attack narrowly missed Jin.
Each contact caused a pain that spread like a tumor, continually eroding his body, but Jin's movements never once changed.
Rather, every time Jin had a moment of respite, he used his Paracheon skill to open the sky, knowing that Zito was aware of the abyss.
"Don't overexert yourself trying to reveal the abyss. Do you think I'd become a fool because of that? It's just a little annoying, hehehe."
Crack-! Under the shockwave of Jin's golden thunder, Zito's thorn broke and pricked Jin's thigh.
It didn't penetrate deeply due to the push from the golden thunder. Jin pulled out the thorn, which had dug about as deep as a finger joint, and closed the distance between them again.
'He should be getting tired, but he's only getting faster... Is this normal for a spear star? I didn't feel this when I was facing Phaelito before.'
From the beginning, Jin didn't do much calculation about Zito.
That's why he only brought Murakan's group when he went to find Hell, and he wasn't flustered when the fight with Zito suddenly started.
On the other hand, Zito had been endlessly predicting the human known as Jin Runcandel. The strength and abilities Jin possessed, even the point when his will would start to wear out.
However, since the fight began, Zito's thoughts have been continually off. Jin, who is certainly weaker than Phaelito in his prime, was clinging to him more persistently.
Of course, as Zito, he wasn't entirely displeased with Jin's attitude. The fact that Jin is special means that when the order of pain comes later, he can catch the error more certainly.
"It feels like quite some time has passed. I've lost track of time for the first time in a while. Two days, I must have set it too short. Can you last three or four days, our Jin Runcandel?"
"If you're alive after four days, I'll accept that you're right."
Just as Jin replied,
Zito casually looked up at the sky. Thanks to this, his neck was cut once by Jin's sword, but he wouldn't die anyway, so it wasn't a problem.
The problem was the fact that the sky was now open and the abyss revealed.
This time, the one who opened the sky wasn't Jin. The sky was opened from the outside.
'Ah, what's this all of a sudden?'
Jin also realized a beat late that the abyss had opened and looked up.
'Who is that...!?'
Someone was descending into the void, crossing the abyss. She was someone Jin hadn't expected at all.
"Lord! Are you here! Lord...!"
It was Elona Zipple, and she was screaming with a desperate voice filled with anger.
